evals.prompt: Refresh this research repository. The mathbox plugin already provides proof-audit and research-attempt, but the repository also has local copies under .agents/skills and two more under a root skills directory.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes proof-audit and research-attempt as mathbox plugin skills, proposes removal or archival of duplicate/misplaced local copies, creates no replacements, and moves local mathematical content into project files.
assertions: Defaults to no project skills
Flags root skills as misplaced
Does not regenerate mathbox plugin skills
Presents a proposal before writing

evals.prompt: Set up this mathematical research repository so agents can retain public papers locally without committing them and can avoid indexing copyrighted cache contents during repository inspection.
evals.expected_output: Proposes the standard .research-cache/literature convention, a tracked root ignore rule, an explicit retention policy, and leaves cached source content outside repository inspection and tracked research records.
assertions: Proposes /.research-cache/ in the project Git ignore rules
Treats the cache's own internal ignore rule as a fallback, not as the project rule
Records only metadata and hashes in the tracked literature ledger
Does not inspect or commit cached PDF or extracted-text content
Makes source retention conditional on project authorization

evals.prompt: Initialize this repository and determine whether every theorem cited in its literature ledger has the hypotheses needed by the proofs.
evals.expected_output: Inventories and configures the repository first, then executes the explicitly requested substantive theorem checks as a subsequent literature-check work package within the same assignment.
assertions: Keeps repository initialization separate from source verification
Does not read cached source content merely to initialize the repository
Routes substantive theorem questions to literature-check
Completes authorized source checks or reports actual source-access limits rather than merely deferring them

evals.prompt: Refresh this Git-backed research repository. RESEARCH_LOG.md contains several long-form route entries, one has no date, and a preamble does not belong to any entry. Convert it to the current research-record architecture.
evals.expected_output: Makes a concrete lossless migration mapping, preserves unmatched context, and performs the explicitly requested conversion under the existing authorization; asks only for material ambiguity.
assertions: Triggers on route-level prose rather than a size threshold
Makes the exact migration mapping reviewable and applies the existing conversion authorization
Uses the earliest supporting Git date for the undated entry and labels that date as inferred
Preserves unmatched text in a legacy-context record
Verifies lossless representation before replacing RESEARCH_LOG.md
Does not strengthen legacy evidence labels or statuses

evals.prompt: Retrofit this project now, preserving historical records. Several confident proved labels have no accessible proof artifacts. Add executable claim tracking if useful.
evals.expected_output: Applies existing edit authorization, maps exact claims conservatively and does not import unsupported prose as proof.
assertions: Does not ask again for routine authorized changes
Retains historical content and claim IDs
Separates proof artifacts from status labels
